guide.title: Burke Mountain Resort, Vermont: East Burke's academy hill, out of receivership
guide.intro: Burke Mountain Resort's own site brands the area "Est. 1956," and states that skiing at Burke traces to trails first cut in 1953. The resort's own site places Burke in East Burke, Vermont, seven miles from Interstate 91, per the resort's own homepage. Burke Mountain spent nearly a decade in federal receivership tied to what WCAX described as "the $200 million EB-5 Kingdom con" before Bear Den Partners was announced as its buyer in April 2025.

sections.heading: Receivership, and a buyer announced
sections.body: Burke Mountain spent nearly a decade in federal receivership tied to what WCAX described as "the $200 million EB-5 Kingdom con" before Bear Den Partners was announced as its buyer in April 2025, per WCAX's own reporting. Bear Den Partners — described by WCAX as "an ownership group with local ties" that had "been working on this now for four years" — plans roughly $10 million of capital investment over the first two years of ownership and aims to triple snowmaking capacity.

sections.heading: Burke Mountain Academy
sections.body: Burke Mountain Academy, founded in 1970 in East Burke, trains alpine ski racers on the slopes of Burke Mountain, per the academy's own website.

sections.heading: In East Burke
sections.body: Kingdom Trails Association is a charitable non-profit founded in 1994 and based in East Burke that manages, maintains, and builds the Kingdom Trails multi-use trail network on privately owned land, according to the association's own website. The Inn at Mountain View Farm is a historic inn with guest rooms and suites on a working farm estate in East Burke, listed on the National Register of Historic Places as part of Vermont's Darling Hill Historic District, per the inn's own website.

faq.question: Who owns Burke Mountain now?
faq.answer: Burke Mountain spent nearly a decade in federal receivership tied to the EB-5 fraud case that also touched Jay Peak, before Bear Den Partners, described by WCAX as "an ownership group with local ties," was announced as its buyer in April 2025.

faq.question: Is Burke Mountain connected to Burke Mountain Academy?
faq.answer: Burke Mountain Academy, founded in East Burke in 1970, trains alpine ski racers on the slopes of Burke Mountain, per the academy's own website.
